info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Current Account Management API
info.description: The Corporate Current Account Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage their corporate banking needs. This API facilitates the creation and management of corporate current accounts, allowing financial institutions to streamline account setup and maintenance processes. Typical consumers include banks and financial services that require robust solutions for corporate clients. By integrating this API, organizations can offer enhanced banking services tailored to the unique requirements of corporate accounts.

post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of a corporate current account for businesses. It facilitates financial activities for companies, ensuring they have the necessary resources to manage their operations effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a new corporate current account deposit lending operation. It includes all necessary details required for processing the account creation request.
